palette_rules: Colour is a signal, not a fill — thin 1-3px rules and outlines only, never a filled colour block, gradient or drop shadow
Deloitte Bright Green (#0df200, Pantone 2286) is reserved for screen-only micro-accents at most — has no CMYK equivalent, so it must never appear in anything that might be printed
Deloitte Pale Green (#f1f6e4) has no Pantone equivalent — CMYK/screen use only
The green dot is the only graphic device — it belongs in the wordmark and, once, large and pale, behind a section header. Nowhere else.
Every canvas is white — never a colour fill behind body content
The wordmark and body copy render in the system sans-serif stack — no licensed Deloitte typeface ships with this profile; do not claim the real wordmark face
